cmd:
echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/tts_samples.py
echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/run_tts2.sh
python3 -m py_compile /tmp/tts_samples.py && echo script-ok
which unshare setpriv | tr '\n' ' '; echo
nohup bash /tmp/run_tts2.sh > /tmp/tts_samples.log 2>&1 &
sleep 20; echo "--- log:"; tail -6 /tmp/tts_samples.log | cut -c1-220
